reviews.text: Friendly staff very helpful. Great prices for fuel oil in local Ephrata.
reviews.author: Chris M.

reviews.text: Our maintenance man was Bruce and he is a wonderful, knowledgeable, patient, and friendly person. He answered all of my questions and showed me how to operate anything I didn't know how to use. I highly recommend him and the man deserves a raise.
reviews.author: Sandra S.

reviews.text: Our family is a long time customer of John Weidman & Sons and will definitely continue to be a customer. On Saturday morning, we had no heat in the house and the outside temperature was well below freezing.
reviews.author: Jodee L.
